title: Three Seasons and One Short Brush
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：shape　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shape 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the painter ① took the shape that no visitor in the studio would have noted, and he said the taking was the whole of the season. The ② shape, meaning the form itself and not the brush, ran three seasons and stayed unnoted in the book; a shape, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ shape in that studio had the same short brush beside it, and the ④ shape at the far easel, meaning the sketch they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A shape, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the painter said the noting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the shape was the whole of the matter, meaning the order and not the form. The ⑥ shape, meaning the order and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; shape, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both a form and an order. He said the order is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ shape had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the short brush. The ⑧ shape of the whole thing, the painter wrote in May, was one studio and three seasons of noting; shape, he said, is either the sketch at the far easel or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ shape I remember is the form noted in the catalogue, which closed in 2000 and is still noted as the quietest in the studio. A ⑩ shape, my mother said in 2002, is the only form that improves by being noted; every shape, she said, is an order that has agreed to look like a form. She said the order was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 形状；形态（指画室里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 形状；形态（指那种形状本身，与小小的画笔相对）
C. 固定搭配：take the shape 定这一种形状
D. n. 形状；形态（指留给孩子们留着的那一幅）
E. n. 形状之事（抽象总称，指一处画室的形状之事）
F. n. 形状；形态（指展品目录里写到、被记下的那一种）
G. n. 形状、样子（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 样子（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: took the shape that no visitor in the studio would have noted
The shape, meaning the form itself and not the brush
the shape at the far easel
the shape was the whole of the matter
the shape had become a line in a catalogue
The shape of the whole thing
A shape, my mother said in 2002

answers.why: take the shape 意为“定这一种形状”，1993 年那位画师把画室里没有一位观者肯记下的一种形状做了一遍。
shape 意为“形状；形态”，指那种形状本身而不是小小的画笔，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被记下。
shape 意为“形状；形态”，指画室里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一支小小的画笔。
shape 意为“形状；形态”，指最远那副画架的留给孩子们留着的那一幅，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
shape 意为“形状、样子”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种样子就是那件事的全部。
shape 意为“样子”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种形状，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
shape 意为“形状；形态”，指展品目录里写到、被记下的那一种，到 1998 年这一种成了展品目录里的一行。
shape 意为“形状之事”，画师五月写道，整件事的形状之事是一处画室和三个季度的记下。
shape 意为“形状；形态”，我记得的是展品目录里记下过的那一种，2000 年画成了，至今仍被说成画室里最安静的一种。
shape 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，形状是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的形状。

那种形状，指的是那种形状本身而不是小小的画笔，经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被记下。（shape）

叔叔说这种样子就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那种形状。（shape）
